'''John Mark Dean''' (October 2, 1936 – March 27, 2025) was an American [[Conservation biology|conservationist]] and [[Marine biology|marine biologist]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://news.cornellcollege.edu/2003/10/10038.html|title=John Mark Dean '58, 2003 Honorary Degree|work=[[Cornell College]]|access-date=July 5, 2025}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Dean was born in [[Cedar Rapids, Iowa]], the son of Kenneth and Verla Dean. He attended and graduated from [[Marshalltown High School]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1265/records/424615550|title=John Mark Dean|publisher=U.S., School Yearbooks, 1900-2016|access-date=July 5, 2025|via=[[Ancestry.com]]}} {{Closed access}} {{Subscription required}}</ref> After graduating, he attended [[Cornell College]], earning his [[Bachelor of Arts|BA degree]] in 1958. He also attended [[Purdue University]], earning his [[Master of Science|MS degree]] in 1960 and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1962, which after earning his degrees, he worked as a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoctoral fellow]] at the [[Duke University Marine Laboratory]].<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/columbia/name/john-dean-obituary?id=58052615|title=John Dean Obituary (1936-2025)|work=[[The Post and Courier]]|date=April 3, 2025|access-date=July 5, 2025|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>

Dean served as a professor in the department of [[earth]] [[ocean]] and [[Ecology|environment]] at the [[University of South Carolina]] from 1977 to 2002.<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sc.edu/study/colleges_schools/artsandsciences/earth_ocean_and_environment/our_people/directory/dean_john.php|title=John Mark Dean|work=[[University of South Carolina]]|access-date=July 5, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sc.edu/about/offices_and_divisions/provost/forms/emeritifaculty_1997-2015.pdf|title=Emeriti Faculty 1997-2015|work=[[University of South Carolina]]|access-date=July 5, 2025}}</ref> During his years as a professor, in 2001, he was named a [[distinguished professor]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchplanning.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/jmdean.pdf|title=John Mark Dean|work=Research Planning|access-date=July 5, 2025}}</ref>

== Death ==
Dean died on March 27, 2025, at his home in [[West Columbia, South Carolina]], at the age of 88.<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/obituaries/name/john-dean-obituary?pid=208877063|title=Dr. John Mark Dean|work=Legacy|access-date=July 5, 2025|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>
